title: Infinite Video: chain MiniMax H3 windows past one clip's length (long video, and the windowing Video Edit and other video jobs reuse)
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1134 - Story and Infinite Video (Phase 4). Picked up 2026-10-29 (Fabio). Two consumers: the Infinite Video Flow (long take from one prompt) and the windowed edit pass for Video Edit MPI-1335 (Fabio 2026-10-29: everything that copies a video is windowed; foley and other video jobs reuse it). Research: research/ (Motion Context V2 workflow notes, Video Edit's window requirements). Method not picked yet: our MpiWindowedSampler vs Viggle five_frame_anchor vs the Motion Context latent-context approach.
